categoryUrl.title: Category URL
categoryUrl.description: URL of the moebelix.cz furniture category to scrape, e.g. https://www.moebelix.cz/zahradni-nabytek-C16. A bare path or slug (zahradni-nabytek-C16) works too. Use a category listing page (URLs ending with -C<number>) — those list all products of the category including its subcategories.

maxItems.title: Maximum items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of products to scrape. Use 0 for no limit (the whole category).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy to use for scraping. Apify proxy is strongly recommended — the site is protected by Cloudflare. The proxy password is read from the APIFY_PROXY_PASSWORD environment variable, which the Apify platform injects automatically.
